sessions.title: Kleine Spiele, große Fragen: Entwirf ein Minispiel mit Botschaft
sessions.desc:
Small Games, Big Questions: Design a Mini Game That Says Something

In Food for Thought's games, mini games carry the message. In Sibel's Journey, a short consent story or a matching game opens up conversations about identity, respect and boundaries. In Leila's Play, small puzzles show barriers that many people never notice.Participants start as players. For 20 minutes they try out a selection of these mini games and look at how each one works: what the player does, what they feel and what they take away.Then they become designers. In small groups they pick a theme that matters to them and invent a mini game around it: a goal, a few rules and one moment where the player understands something new. They sketch it, present it to the group and test it together.For ages 11 to 15. Facilitated in German and English. We bring our own tablets and all materials. No registration needed. Drop-ins are welcome until the group is full.
sessions.like: young people (11 to 15) who want to invent a small game about something that matters

sessions.title: Playable for Everyone
sessions.desc:
Game Design workshop

This workshop explores accessibility in games through a mix of short input and hands-on, gamified ideation. After a concise introduction to common barriers and existing solutions, participants engage in structured exercises to generate new ideas for inclusive game design. The focus lies on experimentation, perspective shifts, and actionable concepts. The session aims to expand how developers and players think about accessibility beyond current standards.

Dieser Workshop beschäftigt sich mit Barrierefreiheit in Games, mit einer Mischung aus kurzem Input und praktischer, spielerischer Ideenentwicklung. Nach einer kompakten Einführung in häufige Barrieren und bestehende Lösungen entwickeln die Teilnehmenden in strukturierten Übungen neue Ideen für inklusives Game Design.
Im Mittelpunkt stehen Experimentieren, Perspektivwechsel und umsetzbare Konzepte. Ziel ist es, den Blick von Entwickler*innen und Spieler*innen auf Barrierefreiheit über die aktuellen Standards hinaus zu erweitern.
sessions.like: accessible games and designing games everyone can play

You’ll also learn how to find your community, connect with other creators and players, and get support when you need it. Finally, we look at the business side: monetisation, marketing, partnerships and how to build something that lasts.

Danach überlegt die Gruppe gemeinsam, warum die Hunde getan haben, was sie getan haben, und was uns das über Menschen verraten kann, die wir kennen. The Golden Bone has gone missing! Children play Arthur, the dog detective, and question the dogs who were at the park to solve the case. Then the group works out together why the dogs did what they did, and what that might tell us about people we know. For ages 6 to 10, together with their parents. Facilitated in German and English.

sessions.where: Main building · right of the Main Entry
sessions.title: My Chat Became My Home. Then It Got Ugly.
sessions.desc:
First safe chat, the red flags and the one boundary every creator needs

Your first livestream will be chaotic, and that's okay. But there are some mistakes you don't have to make yourself. In 45 minutes, our creators share their best tips for getting started and the mishaps they laugh about today. Then we’ll talk about hate and online harassment: what they do to people, how to react in the moment, and when to set boundaries. How to build a community with integrity, set clear rules, and still stay true to yourself.  And finally, an honest look at how quickly viewers can develop parasocial relationships. For everyone who wants to stream, is already streaming, or just enjoys watching.
sessions.like: starting to stream, and how creators deal with hate and set boundaries

sessions.title: Kann man das noch reparieren?
sessions.desc:
Der Button auf dem Controller ist zu schwergängig und der Stick zu leicht, außerdem ist die Playstation schon ziemlich verstaubt und läuft heiß. Aber was davon muss man wegschmeißen, was kann man selber reparieren und wovon sollte man lieber die Finger lassen bevor man sich verletzt? Martin Wagner, Techniker im Computerspielemuseum, spricht mit euch über Heimreparaturen und ihre Vorteile und Gefahren und wie Ihr Elektroschrott sicher vermeiden könnt.

Your controller button is stuck and the stick is lose, also the Playstation is dusty and runs hot. But what do you have to throw away, what can you fix yourself and what shouldn't you touch because you could get hurt? Martin Wagner, technician in the Computerspielemuseum, talks about homerepairs, it's upsides and dangers and how to avoid electronic waste as safely as you can.
sessions.like: fixing your own controller or console and knowing what is safe to repair

sessions.like: game soundtracks played as jazz and rock by a live band
